// Positive control for [NS-33-R11] (BL-1915): a class component Avatar, `export default class Avatar extends ...`, that
// renders an Image and drops the prop. Fictional family only.
import React from 'react';
import { Image } from 'react-native';
export default class Avatar extends React.Component<{ uri: string }> {
  render() {
    return <Image source={{ uri: this.props.uri }} accessibilityLabel="Asha" />;
  }
}
